Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
function validate() {
    var phone = document.getElementById("phone");
    var phone_regex = /^\(?([0-9]{3})\)?[-. ]?([0-9]{3})[-. ]?([0-9]{4})$/;

    if (phone.value.match(phone_regex)) {
        return true;
    } else {
        alert("Re-enter number in XXX XXX XXXX or XXX-XXX-XXXX or XXX.XXX.XXXX formats");
        phone.focus();
        return false;
    }
}
